blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: search tree — Branches of possible decisions.

blocks.title: Define and predict
blocks.text: Backtracking explores a choice, tests whether its state remains viable, then undoes the choice if it cannot lead to a solution.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A search tree records choices and alternative branches. Pruning avoids expanding branches already proven invalid.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: A correct search needs a stopping condition. Pruning on sum>target only works when remaining numbers cannot reduce the sum (e.g. non-negative inputs).

blocks.title: Worked example · Follow the reasoning
blocks.text: Return from the failed choice of4 before excluding3. The state returns to [1], then choosing4 reaches5. Recursive local totals restore on return; mutable state needs an explicit undo.
